title: Annihilator of an element under flat base change
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a flat ring map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $x\in R$. Write $\mathrm{Ann}_R(x)=\{r\in R:rx=0\}$ and $\mathrm{Ann}_S(\varphi(x))=\{s\in S:s\varphi(x)=0\}$. Then $\mathrm{Ann}_S(\varphi(x))=\mathrm{Ann}_R(x)S$, the ideal of $S$ generated by $\varphi(\mathrm{Ann}_R(x))$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07T8 (lemma-annihilator-flat-base-change, line 9364), first assertion, with $M=R$ and $m=x$ (so $m\otimes1=\varphi(x)$ in $R\otimes_RS=S$); proof: tensor the exact sequence $0\to\mathrm{Ann}_R(x)\to R\xrightarrow{\cdot x}R$ with $S$
